name: Neritic-Minaret
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond crystal cavern networks the sky stays the color of a bruise.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Established during the last boom, the pirate hideout was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Whoever controls geothermal energy controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
